svg.title: What ovat setup does
svg.desc: ovat setup checks the platform: macOS has no build and exits 0, Windows gets the Python-enabled zip, Linux reads /etc/os-release and falls back to ubuntu24 with a warning. It downloads the archive, checks the SHA-256 when one is published, refuses on a mismatch, then extracts into ~/.ovat/ovms.

g.text: Linux: it reads /etc/os-release for ubuntu22, ubuntu24 or redhat.

font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Is a .sha256 checksum published for it?

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: No: there is nothing to check. It is reported installed-unverified.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: No: it refuses and installs nothing.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Yes: it extracts, flattens the ovms/ wrapper and makes every member owner-writable.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: OVMS lands in ~/.ovat/ovms: bin/ovms on Linux, ovms.exe on Windows.

text.style: font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pick the build for the platform, download, verify the SHA-256 when published, extract to ~/.ovat/ovms.
